How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question — using Nurosym consistently and correctly helps you get the most out of it.
Basic setup
Apply a little moisture to the tragus (the small cartilage in front of your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left tragus, with the cable looping over and behind your ear. 
Start the session
Turn on Nurosym.
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling in your ear.
During the session
You can sit, relax, or do normal activities like reading, working, or meditating. 
If the sensation fades or becomes stronger, adjust the intensity back to a comfortable tingling. 
Recommended routine
Use 30–60 minutes per day
Best in the morning, or split into morning and evening sessions before sleep. 
Many people use it during calm activities like meditation, breathing exercises, or evening wind‑down routines to make it part of a daily habit.
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s best to speak with our clinical team before getting started.
